verdict.rationale: Datalab documents a dedicated 'Document Segmentation' feature that splits multi-document PDFs into separate logical sections, matching the core 'one upload, per-document results' need, and this pairs with structured extraction/checkpoint APIs for per-segment processing. However, the docs don't explicitly describe automatic classification/labeling of each split document type, and there's no independent or hands-on validation of segmentation accuracy. Missing for 10: explicit classification-of-document-type evidence, and third-party/hands-on confirmation of segmentation quality.
